title: Joshua's Farewell Speech
description: Joshua gathers the people at Shechem, reminds them of the Lord's deeds, and challenges them to choose whom they will serve. The people promise to serve the Lord, and Joshua makes a covenant with them.

versions.title: Joshua's Farewell Speech
versions.description: Joshua challenges the people: 'Choose today whom you will serve! But as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.'
